title: Toolbar layout: menu leftmost then Column Selection; then the 5 filters
refs: SV-8679 (IV spec v10 2026-08-24 Story 12 S12-R2; S12-R3 — leftmost filter is the "as of" date control rather than a date range)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open.
steps:
1. Look at the toolbar's action cluster and read the order of its controls.
2. Read the toolbar filters from left to right.
expected:
1. In the toolbar, the three-dot download menu sits leftmost in the action cluster, followed by the Column Selection control.
2. The toolbar filters run, left to right: the "as of" date control, the part search, the Category filter, the Vendor filter, and the Location filter (rightmost).

This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582 and the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S12-R2; S12-R3), read on 26 August 2026.
An earlier version of this specification described a date-range control in this position; version 10 replaced it with the single "as of" date control (Chris, 2026-08-13), and we take the later version as prevailing.
This expectation has not been checked against any build since the specification change described above.

AUTOMATION: READY
